description.text: Program Description Administrative management is a kind of management of social affairs by using state power. It may also refer to the administration of administrative affairs of all enterprises and institutions. Administrative management system is an organizational system. It is an important subsystem of the social system. With the development of society, the object of administrative management is increasingly extensive, including economic construction, cultural education, municipal construction, social order, public health, environmental protection and other aspects. Modern administrative management applies system engineering ideas and methods to reduce the expenditure and waste of manpower, material resources, financial resources and time, and improve the efficiency and efficiency of administrative management. Duration 3 years

duration.text: The Administration Management at Tongji University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3986 USD/per year ￥ 28700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Copy of article or papers published Catalogue and abstract of published paper, and other documents that can prove academic ability, and special documents required by the target college. 8. Study plan Research or study plan inChina

requirements.text: 1. University graduate, non-Chinese citizen with Old HSK Band 3 or New HSK Band 4 for Medicine, Science and Engineering, Original certificate of Old HSK Band 6 or New HSK Band 5 (Total Score: over 180) for the program of Liberal Arts
